Root Cause: Drain-plug washer reused at oil change; crankcase leak starved big-end bearing
Why Chain: Knock from crankcase > Big-end short of oil > Oil level fell to 52% > Drain plug weeping > Old washer reused at last oil change
Resolution: Replaced washer, renewed big-end shells, topped up to 72%, restarted unloaded
Preventive Action: New washer added to oil-change job card; oil level logged every shift

Root Cause: Non-specified rubber gasket on discharge flange hardened and cracked
Why Chain: Gas smell > 25% LEL at discharge flange > Gasket hardened and cracked > Wrong gasket grade fitted > No line-class gasket list in stores
Resolution: Isolated, purged, replaced gasket with specified grade, soap tested
Preventive Action: Line-class gasket list created; 24 h re-torque on flange jobs

Root Cause: Silica deposits on ionisation probe from siloxanes
Why Chain: Lockouts every few hours > Flame signal 2 µA > Probe coated with white silica > Probe cleaned only yearly
Resolution: Cleaned probe, electrode and burner head; signal back to 9 µA
Preventive Action: Quarterly burner cleaning; monthly flame-signal log; siloxane sampling

Symptom: Heavy thud at start-up after weekend stop
Root Cause: Knock-out pot auto-drain stuck; condensate entered cylinder
Why Chain: Thud at start > Liquid in cylinder > Knock-out pot full > Auto-drain stuck with sludge > Drain not on checksheet
Resolution: Drained pot and cylinders, changed milky oil, replaced one cracked suction plate
Preventive Action: Pot high-level alarm; drain step added to start-up SOP and checksheet

Symptom: Low gas pressure lockouts on cold mornings
Why Chain: Lockout low gas > Pressure 12 mbar on ignition > Condensate trap full > Trap not on shift round
Resolution: Drained trap, cleaned gas filter, fitted auto-drain
Preventive Action: Trap drain on HWG checksheet; auto-drain fitted

Symptom: Black powder in suction strainer and rising vibration
Root Cause: Scrubber outlet mesh perimeter seal gap let media through
Why Chain: Vibration > Damaged suction valves > Media granules in suction > Outlet mesh seal gap > Internals not inspected at media change
Resolution: CMP-01 trip, cleaned suction vessel, replaced 2 valves, re-seated media and seal
Preventive Action: Mesh and seal inspection on every media change (SOP-SCR-02)

Root Cause: Sealed-for-life bearing run past its life
Why Chain: Rumble > Bearing 84 °C > Raceway spalled > Bearing at 31000 h > No running-hour replacement
Resolution: Replaced bearings and shaft seal; trended vibration
Preventive Action: Sealed bearings replaced at OEM hours; monthly vibration readings

Symptom: ID fan belt squeal at start-up
Root Cause: Belt tension low and pulleys misaligned after motor change
Why Chain: Squeal > Belts slipping > Tension low and pulleys 3 mm out of line > Aligned by eye > No re-tension step
Resolution: Replaced matched belt set, laser aligned, re-tensioned after 4 h
Preventive Action: Alignment laser issued; re-tension at 4 h and 24 h on job card

Symptom: High stage-3 discharge temperature trips in afternoons
Root Cause: Air-cooler fins packed with dust from feed hall
Why Chain: Trip at 165 °C > Intercooler not removing heat > Fins blocked by dust > No cleaning interval for dry season
Resolution: Cleaned fins, replaced slack fan belt
Preventive Action: Monthly fin cleaning (fortnightly in dry season); dust screen fitted

Symptom: Belt squeal and low flare flow
Root Cause: Belts glazed from misalignment after motor change
Why Chain: Squeal > Belts slipping > Pulleys out of line > Aligned by eye
Resolution: Replaced belt set, laser aligned, re-tensioned
Preventive Action: Re-tension and alignment record on job card

Symptom: Valve-cover clatter and hot suction valve
Root Cause: Fatigue crack in stage-2 suction plate after 11000 h
Why Chain: Clatter > Broken plate > Fatigue from port edge > Valves overhauled only on failure
Resolution: Replaced plates and springs as a set, lapped seat, re-torqued covers
Preventive Action: Valve overhaul every 6000 h; weekly valve-cover IR

Symptom: Rising vibration and water at casing drain
Root Cause: Upstream condensate trap blocked; water and sulphur in side channel
Why Chain: Vibration > Impeller unbalanced > Condensate and sulphur crust > Upstream trap blocked > Trap had no cleaning interval
Resolution: Drained and cleaned casing and impeller, cleared trap
Preventive Action: Monthly trap cleaning; casing drain on shift round

Symptom: Frequent trips on high pressure with normal local gauge
Root Cause: Pressure transmitter impulse line full of water
Why Chain: Trips > SCADA reading 2 bar above local gauge > Impulse line waterlogged > No drain pot on impulse line
Resolution: Drained impulse line, fitted drain pot, recalibrated transmitter

Root Cause: Loop strainer choked and air lock after pump maintenance
Why Chain: High-limit trip > Low water flow > Strainer choked and air in loop > No venting step after maintenance
Resolution: Cleaned strainer, vented loop, ΔT back to 10 °C
Preventive Action: Loop restart checklist with venting; flow switch interlock

Symptom: Gas at rod packing vent and falling capacity
Root Cause: Rod packing and rings worn by silica deposits
Why Chain: Gas at vent > Packing worn > Abrasive silica > Siloxanes not monitored
Resolution: Replaced packing, rings and rider bands; polished rod
Preventive Action: Quarterly siloxane test; ring and packing change by running hours

Symptom: Sooty pulsing flame after burner service
Root Cause: Air damper linkage slipped; no combustion test after service
Why Chain: Soot and pulsing > Too little air > Damper linkage slipped > No flue analysis after service
Resolution: Re-tuned to O2 4.5% and CO 40 ppm, locked linkage
Preventive Action: Flue gas analysis mandatory after burner work
